hivemindAdaptations: Clean-room HivemindOS-authored adaptation of the wiki-first research-project pattern from public agent-research workflow writeups; no upstream text is vendored.
Routes durable cross-session knowledge into the HivemindOS shared brain (typed memory + compiled wiki) instead of a parallel private wiki index.
Chains the kill-my-thesis adversarial gate and the research-call-tracker publish-time log as fail-closed steps.
Keeps project scaffolds in user-designated folders so raw data blobs stay out of the shared brain vault.
